comment: Gameplay routes for port/tools/regress (docs/port/REGRESSION.md). Each level starts directly (OPENRAC_DIRECT with --level N), presses Cross through the boot screens, holds Start through scenes and the flight until control, then plays its sequence. Step frames count from control, so every version plays the same moments. A level may name another sequence, change length or max_frames, and override any of that per game under its game's id.

versions.why: random and timed spawns (the shower, debris, bombs, bolts) do not happen at the same tick; the random sequence parts early in the level, where the sky walks low memory that differs between the runs (docs/port/RAC1_NTSC_HINTS.md 7)

the scene before control ends two ticks apart (the route's Start presses fall on window frames, and the versions reach the level at other frames), so the level's mobys run that much out of step with the hero (RAC1_NTSC_HINTS.md 7)
